citations.title: Security — Every Action Passes Through Policy First | Naïve
excerpts: Secure by design. Built for trust. Your data is stored with established third-party infrastructure providers that maintain industry security and privacy standards. A list of subprocessors and provider attestations is available upon request at [support@usenaive.ai](mailto:support@usenaive.ai) . Control your agent's autonomy, protect your business data, and scale with the same rigor as your enterprise stack. Your data is not used to train models We do not use your proprietary business data, prompts, or agent memory to train our foundational models. Your company's intellectual property stays yours. Agent Guardrails & Approvals You decide the level of autonomy. Set strict guardrails, require explicit human approval for sensitive actions (like spending money or publishing), and review agent drafts before they go live. Secure Secrets Management When you connect third-party apps (Stripe, Meta, LinkedIn), your API keys and OAuth tokens are encrypted at rest and scoped to specific agent workflows. They are never exposed in plaintext. Isolation by Design Your company workspace, agent context, and customer data are logically separated. Strict tenant boundaries ensure your data is never accessible to other organizations. Protected Infrastructure Hosted on established cloud and data providers that maintain industry security and privacy standards, with encryption in transit and at rest. Subprocessor details available upon request at support@usenaive.ai.
